sub.zh: 在内置 K3 模型假设下，比较量化层级、context 内存与显存预算。
sub.en: Compare quant tiers, context memory and VRAM budgets under an embedded K3 model profile.

caption.zh: 显式预算 · 模型假设

body.zh: 固定状态、KV 和活动权重分别计算。
body.en: Fixed state, KV and active weights are accounted separately.

body.zh: 同一预算下查看各档 context 估计。
body.en: Inspect per-tier context estimates under one budget.

body.zh: 输入为预算与源码中的 profile，计算可离线执行。
body.en: Budgets and the source profile are enough for an offline calculation.

title.en: Expose the assumptions behind an estimate

body.zh: 计划下载和部署大权重前，可以先按明确的模型参数计算权重与上下文内存。K3Fit 将固定状态层、逐 token KV、活动专家和量化系数分开计算，输出每档估计。它的模型常量在源码中标为 schema-unverified，需要与你实际使用的模型核对。
body.en: Before downloading and deploying large weights, explicit model assumptions can support a preliminary memory account. K3Fit separates fixed state, per-token KV, active experts and quant coefficients to produce estimates per tier. Its constants are marked schema-unverified in source and must be checked against the actual model.

body.zh: 两个明确预算场景运行真实 CLI，结果仅验证内置公式的执行。没有核对官方 K3 规格、运行模型或测量吞吐；报告中的倍数与百分比都是给定假设下的计算值。
body.en: Two explicit budget scenarios run the real CLI and exercise its formulas. They do not verify official K3 specifications, run a model or measure throughput; ratios and ranges are calculations under the embedded assumptions.

alt.zh: 两个明确预算场景运行真实 CLI，结果仅验证内置公式的执行。没有核对官方 K3 规格、运行模型或测量吞吐；报告中的倍数与百分比都是给定假设下的计算值。
alt.en: Two explicit budget scenarios run the real CLI and exercise its formulas. They do not verify official K3 specifications, run a model or measure throughput; ratios and ranges are calculations under the embedded assumptions.

body.zh: model 计算固定状态与 KV 内存；quant 提供 bits-per-weight 表；fit 用显存减去活动权重与固定状态，求最大 context；tps 用固定 240 GB/s 常量除以活动权重。报告保留每档结果，未运行推理。
body.en: model computes fixed-state and KV memory; quant supplies bits-per-weight values. fit subtracts active weights and fixed state from VRAM to derive a maximum context. tps divides a fixed 240 GB/s constant by active weights. Reports retain per-tier estimates without running inference.

alt.zh: model 计算固定状态与 KV 内存；quant 提供 bits-per-weight 表；fit 用显存减去活动权重与固定状态，求最大 context；tps 用固定 240 GB/s 常量除以活动权重。报告保留每档结果，未运行推理。
alt.en: model computes fixed-state and KV memory; quant supplies bits-per-weight values. fit subtracts active weights and fixed state from VRAM to derive a maximum context. tps divides a fixed 240 GB/s constant by active weights. Reports retain per-tier estimates without running inference.

body.zh: K3Fit 是一个假设可检查的计算器，不读取 GGUF 元数据或实际硬件，也不执行推理。下载与硬件选型前仍需验证模型规格、完整权重驻留需求和运行时开销。
body.en: K3Fit is an inspectable calculator. It does not read GGUF metadata, probe actual hardware or execute inference. Check model specifications, full residency needs and runtime overhead before relying on a deployment decision.

alt.zh: K3Fit 是一个假设可检查的计算器，不读取 GGUF 元数据或实际硬件，也不执行推理。下载与硬件选型前仍需验证模型规格、完整权重驻留需求和运行时开销。
alt.en: K3Fit is an inspectable calculator. It does not read GGUF metadata, probe actual hardware or execute inference. Check model specifications, full residency needs and runtime overhead before relying on a deployment decision.

body.zh: --ram 以告警门参与求解：某档位磁盘权重超过内存预算时，报告会提示 mmap 将从磁盘换页，吞吐估计的前提不再成立。
body.en: --ram now gates the report as a warning: when a tier's on-disk weights exceed the RAM budget, the report flags that mmap will page from disk and the tps estimate's precondition no longer holds.

note.zh: 两个明确预算场景运行真实 CLI，结果仅验证内置公式的执行。没有核对官方 K3 规格、运行模型或测量吞吐；报告中的倍数与百分比都是给定假设下的计算值。
note.en: Two explicit budget scenarios run the real CLI and exercise its formulas. They do not verify official K3 specifications, run a model or measure throughput; ratios and ranges are calculations under the embedded assumptions.

body.zh: 按 32 GiB 显存预算计算各档结果。
body.en: Calculate per-tier results under a 32 GiB VRAM budget.

steps.output:
K3Fit — Kimi K3 Delta-Attention Fit Planner
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Rig:  32 GiB VRAM | 128 GiB RAM
Model: Kimi K3 — 2.8T params, MoE 896×16, 93 layers (69 Delta-Attention + 24 KV)

Delta-Attention memory at 1M context
+--------------------------------------------------+-------+------------------------------------------+
|                    COMPONENT                     |  GIB  |                  NOTES                   |
+--------------------------------------------------+-------+------------------------------------------+
| DA matrix (69 layers × 2 heads × 128×128 × fp16) |  0.00 | 128×128 matrix/head, context-independent |
| KV cache (24 layers × 1M tokens)                 | 22.89 | standard per-token KV cache              |
| Total (Delta-Attention)                          | 22.89 | at 1M ctx                                |
| (Standard KV — all 93 layers)                    | 88.69 | what generic profilers compute           |
+--------------------------------------------------+-------+------------------------------------------+
Delta-Attention saves 3.9× vs standard KV-cache at 1M context.

Quant fit analysis (VRAM = 32 GiB)

| Q3_K_M |  3.27 |      1065.9 |  366728 |    256K |  yes  |
| Q4_K_S |  3.50 |      1140.9 |  294198 |    256K |  yes  |
| Q4_K_M |  4.25 |      1385.3 |   57687 |     32K |  yes  |
| Q5_K_S |  5.00 |      1629.8 |       — |       — |  no   |
| Q5_K_M |  5.25 |      1711.3 |       — |       — |  no   |
| Q6_K   |  6.10 |      1988.4 |       — |       — |  no   |
| Q8_0   |  8.00 |      2607.7 |       — |       — |  no   |
| F16    | 16.00 |      5215.4 |       — |       — |  no   |
+--------+-------+-------------+---------+---------+-------+
Weights GiB = total model on disk (mmap). Max Ctx = VRAM-resident ceiling.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Recommendation: Q2_K at 512K context
Expert routing:  16 of 896 experts active per token (1.8% activation)
Predicted decoding tps ≈ 12 (heuristic, ±30% → 8–16)
Disk required:  ~835 GiB (Q2_K GGUF)
VRAM at 512K:      30.5 GiB (weights 18.5 + ctx 12.0) / 32 GiB budget
RAM warning:     weights 835 GiB exceed the 128 GiB RAM budget — mmap will page from disk; the tps estimate assumes RAM-resident weights
1M context:      does NOT fit at any quant — max is 589837 tokens (576K) at Q2_K

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。计算不需要 GPU、模型文件或模型服务。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+. The calculation needs no GPU, model file or model service.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/k3fit.git
cd k3fit
go build -o k3fit ./cmd/k3fit

limitations.zh: 内置模型参数明确未完成 schema 验证，不应当作已核实官方规格。
limitations.en: Embedded model constants are explicitly schema-unverified, not confirmed official specifications.

limitations.zh: RAM 以告警门参与 fit（磁盘权重对比预算）；吞吐估计仍未读取硬件带宽。
limitations.en: RAM is enforced as a warning gate (on-disk weights vs budget); throughput still does not use measured device bandwidth.

limitations.zh: 这些输出不构成实测性能或部署成功保证。
limitations.en: These outputs are not measured performance or a guarantee of successful deployment.
